skill.name: ena-database
skill.description: Access European Nucleotide Archive APIs and public download services for sequences, raw reads, assemblies, taxonomy, and metadata.
skill.summary: Retrieve ENA sequence data and metadata for genomics workflows.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from documentation examples for official ENA and EBI services. The only confirmed issue is the recommendation to use plaintext FTP for bulk downloads, which needs checksum validation or safer transfer options. No prompt injection, covert endpoint, or executable shell behavior was found.

remediation.issue: Plaintext FTP is recommended for bulk ENA downloads.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer HTTPS or Aspera where available, and require checksum verification for files retrieved over FTP.

content.value_statement: Finding ENA accessions, metadata, and sequence files can be slow for genomics teams. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code structured ENA API guidance.
actual_capabilities: Explains ENA studies, samples, runs, assemblies, sequences, analyses, and taxonomy records.
Documents Portal API searches for metadata, samples, studies, read runs, assemblies, and taxa.
Shows Browser API retrieval patterns for XML, text, FASTA, links, and cross-references.
Guides FASTQ file report lookups with fields for download URLs, checksums, and file sizes.
Summarizes rate limits, retry handling, pagination, field selection, and query optimization.
Identifies bulk download options, including FTP, Aspera, and enaBrowserTools.
limitations: It provides documentation and examples, not a packaged ENA client library.
It covers public ENA services and does not handle private submission workflows.
Large downloads still require user-managed storage, bandwidth, and transfer tools.
FTP examples need checksum verification or an encrypted alternative for sensitive workflows.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Study Dataset
use_cases.description: Find samples, runs, metadata fields, and FASTQ links for a public ENA study accession.

use_cases.title: Build Search Queries
use_cases.description: Construct Portal API filters for organism, taxonomy, date, assay type, and assembly metadata.

use_cases.title: Support Data Pipelines
use_cases.description: Plan ENA retrieval steps with retry handling, pagination, rate limits, and bulk download choices.

prompt_templates.title: Find Records by Accession
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner lookup for a known accession.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the ENA database skill to explain how I can retrieve metadata for accession ERR123456. Include the best API endpoint.

prompt_templates.title: Search Samples in a Study
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the ENA database skill to design a Portal API search for all samples in study PRJNA123456. Include useful fields.

prompt_templates.title: Plan FASTQ Downloads
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the ENA database skill to outline how to find FASTQ URLs, MD5 checksums, and byte sizes for run ERR123456.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize a Bulk Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced pipeline planning for many records.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the ENA database skill to plan a bulk retrieval workflow for 2,000 bacterial runs. Include rate limits and validation steps.

output_examples.input: Find FASTQ files for run ERR123456.
output_examples.output: Use the ENA file report endpoint for read runs. Request run accession, FASTQ links, checksums, and file sizes before transfer.
Use the Portal API assembly result type with a taxonomy tree query. Return assembly accession, scientific name, and quality fields.

output_examples.input: Handle ENA rate limits in a workflow.
output_examples.output: Batch requests, keep below 50 requests per second, retry 429 and 5xx responses, and cache repeated taxonomy lookups.

best_practices: Request only the fields needed for analysis to reduce response size.
Use pagination and retry logic for large result sets.
Verify downloaded files with published checksums before downstream analysis.
anti_patterns: Do not loop through thousands of API requests without rate limiting.
Do not parse XML or tabular responses with brittle string matching.
Do not trust FTP downloads without checksum validation.

faq.question: What database does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers the European Nucleotide Archive, including sequence records, raw reads, assemblies, metadata, and taxonomy APIs.

faq.question: Can it download FASTQ files directly?
faq.answer: It explains how to find FASTQ download links and checksums. The actual transfer is done by user-selected tools.

faq.question: Does it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it require ENA credentials?
faq.answer: No credentials are described for the documented public ENA retrieval workflows.

faq.question: What formats are documented?
faq.answer: The skill documents JSON, TSV, XML, FASTA, FASTQ, BAM, CRAM, and EMBL-oriented retrieval contexts.

faq.question: What is the main security caution?
faq.answer: The references mention FTP for bulk downloads. Prefer encrypted transfer where possible and verify file checksums.
